verses.text: Joshua, son of Nun, sent two dudes from Shittim to check out the land, especially Jericho. They rolled up and crashed at Rahab’s place; she was a prostitute. 🕵️
Word got to Jericho’s king that some peeps from Israel had snuck in to scope out the area. 👂
The king hit up Rahab: ‘Bring out those guys who came to your crib. They’re here to spy.’ 📣
But Rahab had tucked the two guys away. She said, ‘Yeah, some dudes came by, but I didn’t know where they were from. 🤫
‘It was getting dark when they left. I don’t know where they went, but chase them quick—you might catch up.’ 🌑
But she’d taken them up to the roof and hidden them under the flax stalks she’d laid out. 🌾
The king’s men chased after them toward the Jordan crossings. As soon as they were gone, the gate shut. 🏃
Before the scouts settled down, Rahab came up to them on the roof. 🏠
She told the guys, ‘I know Yahweh’s giving you this land, and we’re all scared of you. Everyone’s shook. 😟
‘We heard how Yahweh parted the Red Sea for you when you left Egypt, and what you did to those two Amorite kings, Sihon and Og—total destruction, no cap. 🌊
‘As soon as we heard, our hearts melted. We lost all our courage because of you. Your God is the real deal, up in heaven and down here on earth. ☝️
‘So swear to me by Yahweh: I showed your crew kindness, so show my family kindness too. Give me a solid sign 🙏
‘that you’ll spare my dad, mom, brothers, sisters, and everybody with them. Save our lives from death.’ 🤝
The men told her, ‘We’ll put our lives on the line for yours—if you keep our mission under wraps. When Yahweh hands us the land, we’ll treat you straight and show you kindness.’ ✅
Then she lowered them from the window with a rope. Her house was built into the city wall, and she lived right there in the wall. 🪢
She told them, ‘Head for the hills, so the guys chasing you don’t find you. Stay hidden for three days till they come back, then you can bounce.’ ⛰️
The men said, ‘We’re clear of that oath you had us swear if you don’t break these instructions: 📜
‘When we enter the land, tie this red cord in the same window you used to lower us. Bring your dad, mom, brothers, and your whole family inside your house. 🧵
‘Anybody who steps outside into the street is responsible for their own death; that’s on them, not us. But if someone harms anybody inside your house, that’s on us. 🏠
‘If you tell anyone what we’re doing, we’re off the hook for that oath you had us swear.’ 🤫
She said, ‘Deal. Just like you said.’ Then she sent them off and tied the red cord in the window. 🧵
They went into the hills and stayed there three days, till the pursuers headed back. The pursuers searched the roads but didn’t find them. ⛰️
Then the two men came down from the hills, crossed the river, and got back to Joshua, son of Nun. They filled him in on everything that went down. 🗣️
They told Joshua, ‘Yahweh has handed the whole land over to us for real. Everyone there is shook because of us.’ ✅
